MEASURED LINKED #backstop-diagnosis-hint-only Backstop + Diagnosis as of 2026-11-24

In an exploratory follow-up, dropping the blind N2 fallback (D_only: refuse a stop only when diagnose() produces a hint) preserved 100% of task-success gains across all three models while eliminating regressions at N=843/250 and cutting post-fork wrong actions by 73–79%, though gains remained uneven across families.

Does not showProspective out-of-sample confirmation (D_only was designed from post-hoc G2 findings and evaluated on the same test sets, not unseen seeds). Under the strict registered G2 bootstrap 95th-percentile rule, D_only still misses 1.744 (p95 2.111 on qwen; inf on gemma4) because matching N0 on >80% of tasks shrinks the post-fork denominator. Ministral remains null.

NEGATIVE-RESULT LINKED #backstop-diagnosis-cross-family Backstop + Diagnosis as of 2026-11-24

Exploratory cross-family testing showed artifact-only diagnosis is uneven across 7–9B model families and did not generalize over plain refusal on either gemma4:e4b (which already self-recovers on plain refusal) or ministral-3:8b (which failed to convert D's hints); an external tau2-bench smoke gate failed below a zero-tool floor and was dropped.

Does not showConfirmatory cross-family bounds (exploratory, N=250, single seed) or behavior on external benchmarks where small models clear a zero-tool floor. Five older 7–9B models also failed the tool-calling smoke gate before selection.

NEGATIVE-RESULT LINKED #backstop-diagnosis-confirmatory Backstop + Diagnosis as of 2026-11-24

A preregistered artifact-only diagnosis (built from error text and tool schemas, zero ground truth) lifted qwen2.5:7b error recovery from 16.0% to 42.1% and whole-task success by +5.7 percentage points with clean G1, but failed the post-fork wrong-action guardrail G2 (registered verdict: Gain not clean).

Does not showGeneralization across model families (failed H1 on ministral-3:8b and gemma4:e4b), transfer outside BFCL's eight simulated apps, or silent-failure coverage. Confirmatory N was reduced from 1,000 to 843 after a harness integer-serialization bug at task 844; the labelled secondary N=1,000 set matches every conclusion.
